scope: Executable fixture and reference-oracle invariants. Production snapshot/session/query behavior requires later M1/M3 differential tests.

cases.expectation: Two independently regenerated byte sets and manifests have identical SHA256 values.
Archive SHA differs; full ordered uncompressed member bytes are identical.
Two distinct central-directory member occurrences retain identical DEX bytes and independent local index 0.
Reversing input order reverses ordinal-to-content mapping; content multiset is retained.
First member name and archive identity differ; first member bytes and DEX facts are preserved. HostLab selection must be reevaluated.
On-disk rewritten file keeps length and mtime but SHA differs. This proves fixture behavior only; engine isolation is a later test.
Envelope compression rearranges physical bytes while preserving exact logical DEX contents and interpreted fixture fields.

Independent classes swap class_def_idx; string_data/class_data layouts reverse and all offsets relocate. Every string/type/proto/method/class reference is valid and normalized class/method semantics are equal; file SHA and physical IDs differ. Canonically sorted DEX ID tables are not illegally shuffled.

planned_production_cases: source rename/delete while session retains lease
